paragraphs: Latve looks down at the old tower.

paragraphs.text: “It’ll make my voice louder,” Latve says. “I can use my voice as a weapon.”

paragraphs: A jellyfish rests on her shoulder. One kind puts listeners to sleep, another hypnotizes them, and a third summons a storm. Latve can layer several jellyfish around the same voice.

paragraphs.text: “It starts with the voice. It all depends on what you wrap it in,” says Latve.

paragraphs: How can Latve combine the effects and still speak through the same interface?
imageAlt: Latve stands beside Dre’Kaar above an old tower with a glowing jellyfish on her shoulder

task: Build the diagram for Latve’s voice, the base jellyfish decorator, and the three concrete decorators. Then try stacking their effects.
